title: One of the lower-priced floor chairs, but there is a reason
text:
One of the lower-priced floor chairs, but there is a reason. The Monk and Llama folding floor chair is one of the more affordable floor chairs on Amazon. Has the same type of ratcheting, locking mechanism that allows for various degrees of recline. When folded closed, it features a strap that allow easy carrying.

Unfortunately, I wouldn't recommend this product over others of similar price or features. Starting with the title of the product, the only padded vegan leather I can identify is the black logo area. The rest seem to be microfiber. Beyond that, this floor chair is thinner than other chairs that are in the same price range which means less comfortable. Compared to other "thin" style floor chairs, this chair simply doesn't look as good; The color is a muted purple with a black trim.

Even if one were to overlook the above issues one must consider the carrying strap. This strap simply cannot be detached. It can be seen in the attached pictures that it is sewn in place and is permanent. This is quite perplexing. It means that if this was purchased to be a floor char for daily use, the strap must be dealt with every time the chair is moved. It wouldn't be good to have the strap under the chair as the plastic buckles may damage the flooring material. In my case, it is the straw tatami mat.
